status: untested prompts for invention, not novel-product claims

seeds.mechanism: Inspectable state objects plus staged behavior patches
seeds.experience: Select a broken workspace object; compare a proposed repair on its retained state.
seeds.difference_to_test: Less context reconstruction and fewer lost edits than whole-app correction.
seeds.falsifier: State migration, observation, or recovery costs erase the gain.

seeds.working_name: A game world you can mend
seeds.mechanism: Actor-local rules plus versioned simulation snapshots
seeds.experience: Demonstrate a changed creature behavior while unrelated parts of a small world continue.
seeds.difference_to_test: Useful controlled rule changes during play with preserved world identity.
seeds.falsifier: Rule changes cannot preserve simulation invariants or feel less understandable than ordinary editing.

seeds.mechanism: Incremental dataflow plus source-backed dependency graph
seeds.experience: Change one assumption in research; see only affected conclusions recompute with provenance.
seeds.difference_to_test: Faster inspectable revisions than regenerating the full report.
seeds.falsifier: Hidden dependencies produce stale conclusions or full recomputation is simpler and equally effective.

seeds.mechanism: Bounded operation grammar plus executable examples
seeds.experience: Show a tool one accepted and one rejected behavior; inspect the smallest proposed correction.
seeds.difference_to_test: Counterexamples reduce repair iterations relative to prose error reports.
seeds.falsifier: Example overfitting, representation cost, or missing semantics causes more failures.

seeds.mechanism: Portable local project state plus explicit reconciliation
seeds.experience: Keep editing plans, media notes, and data during disconnection; selectively reconcile on return.
seeds.difference_to_test: Continuity on low-connectivity devices with user-owned outputs.
seeds.falsifier: Model/hardware requirements exceed the device or existing local-first tools already solve the job.

seeds.mechanism: Snapshot branches with external effects replaced by recorded fixtures
seeds.experience: Rehearse an agent workflow on the same input state and compare divergent outcomes before activation.
seeds.difference_to_test: Actionable behavior comparisons with fewer accidental side effects.
seeds.falsifier: The rehearsal omits essential nondeterminism or simulated providers mislead the decision.

seeds.working_name: A document that can show its machinery
seeds.mechanism: Live document objects with bounded tools and editable projections
seeds.experience: Select a chart, ask how it was made, change one operation, and retain both source and human edits.
seeds.difference_to_test: Lower effort to understand and revise generated artifacts.
seeds.falsifier: Projection/source conflicts destroy edits or existing notebooks provide the same interaction.

seeds.mechanism: Supervised small workers with versioned state and effect receipts
seeds.experience: Replace a failing parser while retaining queued work and seeing which actions already happened.
seeds.difference_to_test: Less rework and more understandable recovery for a solo operator.
seeds.falsifier: Duplicate effects, incompatible queued messages, or operating overhead make normal redeployment preferable.
